description: Use this when the person wants a plan to win a specific target account. Builds the buying committee, the opportunities that fit what they sell, the champion to work with, talk tracks and next steps, from sourced research, saved to their Andru account. Returns the plan's link with a short summary. A plan for the same company from the last 30 days comes back at once. Takes 1 to 3 minutes: returns a job_id; call get_asset with it. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

accountName.description: The company to plan for, e.g. "Acme Logistics".

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

productDescription.description: What you sell to this account, if different from the product saved in Andru (a sentence or two).

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

refresh.description: Build a new plan even if one from the last 30 days exists ($12). Default false.

name: get_account_plan
title: Build an account plan
